name: degoog-the-world
description: degoog extensions that I couldn't find anywhere else.
author: rorotheworld

plugins.name: linkding
plugins.description: Integrates a linkding instance into Degoog: an "In your bookmarks" panel alongside search results. Requires Degoog 0.24.0 or newer.

plugins.name: Dictionary
plugins.description: Definitions, pronunciation, synonyms, antonyms, and etymology from a local dictionary server, with PowerThesaurus enrichment. Adapted from SoPat712/degoog-toolkit.

engines.name: linkding Engine
engines.description: Native linkding bookmark search engine: results in a dedicated tab and via the `!linkding` bang shortcut. Which tabs it feeds is set from Degoog's own engine type override.

engines.name: Marginalia
engines.description: Independent web index (small-web, non-commercial sites) via the Marginalia Search API. Merges into the web tab and `!mg` bang.
